name: sst-native
description: SST Trainer native app shell (iOS + Android) — loads the live web app and adds native Bluetooth for every broadcast-capable wearable.

scripts.postinstall: mkdir -p www && [ -f www/index.html ] || printf '<!doctype html><meta http-equiv=refresh content="0;url=https://portal.concussion-education-australia.com/sst-trainer?source=app">' > www/index.html
